examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 规则；规章。可数名词，常说 a rule / school rules；规则通常用 must、have to 或祈使句表达。
collocations: follow a rule; school rules; break the rules
commonMistake: follow the rules 和 obey the rules 都表示“遵守规则”；obey 后不加 to。

example.english: Our school has a rule about keeping the hallway clean.
example.chinese: 我们学校有一条保持走廊整洁的规定。

application.prompt: A school instruction that students must follow is a ___. (rule / treat)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 秩序；命令；v. 点菜；命令。作名词可说 keep order；作动词可说 order food 或 order sb to do sth。
collocations: keep order; order a meal; order sb to wait
commonMistake: 表示“点菜”时 order 后直接接食物；表示“命令某人做某事”用 order sb to do sth。

example.english: Please keep order while the teacher is speaking.
example.chinese: 老师讲话时请保持秩序。

application.prompt: At the school canteen, I ask for a sandwich. I ___ a sandwich. (order / lend)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 遵循；跟随。规则变化 follow—followed—followed；follow 后直接接宾语。
collocations: follow the rules; follow instructions; follow a person
commonMistake: follow 后直接接名词，不加介词 to：follow the rule，不说 follow to the rule。

example.english: Please follow the teacher’s instructions.
example.chinese: 请遵循老师的指示。

application.prompt: Everyone must ___ the safety rules. (follow / follows)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，表示“迟到”；常用 be late for + 课程、活动或交通工具。late 是形容词。
collocations: be late for school; be late for class; be late for the bus
commonMistake: late for 后接迟到的活动或场合；说“准时”用 on time，late 是“迟到”。

example.english: Don’t be late for class again.
example.chinese: 不要再上课迟到了。

application.prompt: The bell has rung, but Kai has not reached class yet. He is ___ class. (late for / on time)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 到达。arrive at 常接较小地点，arrive in 常接城市或国家；过去式 arrived。
collocations: arrive at school; arrive in Beijing; arrive on time
commonMistake: arrive 后通常用 at/in 表示到达地点，不说 arrive to school；但 arrive home 可直接接 home。

example.english: We arrive at school before eight.
example.chinese: 我们八点前到校。

application.prompt: The train will ___ at the station at nine. (arrive / arrive to)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，表示“准时”，即在约定或预定的时间；作时间状语。
collocations: arrive on time; be on time for class; start on time
commonMistake: on time 表示准时；in time 表示及时、来得及，两者含义不同。

example.english: The school bus arrived on time this morning.
example.chinese: 校车今天早上准时到了。

application.prompt: The lesson starts at 8:00, and Ben gets there at 8:00. He is ___. (on time / late for)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 走廊；可数名词，复数 hallways。美式英语常用 hallway，英式英语常用 corridor。
collocations: in the hallway; walk down the hallway; hallway rules
commonMistake: hallway 指楼内供人通行的走廊；不要与 hall（大厅）混淆。

example.english: Please walk quietly in the hallway.
example.chinese: 请在走廊里轻声行走。

application.prompt: Students walk between classrooms along the ___. (hallway / uniform)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 校服；制服。可数名词，复数 uniforms；常与 wear 搭配。
collocations: wear a uniform; school uniform; a police uniform
commonMistake: uniform 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 a/the 或物主限定词，如 wear a uniform。

example.english: We wear our school uniforms on Mondays.
example.chinese: 我们星期一穿校服。

application.prompt: Students wear a school ___ to show which school they attend. (uniform / hallway)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 乱扔；n. 垃圾。作动词可说 litter a place；作名词通常指散落在公共场所的垃圾。
collocations: drop litter; pick up litter; litter the floor
commonMistake: litter 作名词泛指垃圾时通常不可数；作动词表示乱扔垃圾，后可接地点。

example.english: Don’t litter in the school yard.
example.chinese: 不要在校园里乱扔垃圾。

application.prompt: Put the wrapper in the bin; do not ___ on the floor. (litter / arrive)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. 有礼貌的。可作表语或定语；副词为 politely，常见结构 It is polite to do sth。
collocations: be polite to sb; a polite request; speak politely
commonMistake: polite 是形容词；修饰动词 speak 要用副词 politely。

example.english: It is polite to say “please” when asking for help.
example.chinese: 请求帮助时说“请”是有礼貌的。

application.prompt: A kind request with “please” sounds ___. (polite / politely)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 对待；招待；治疗；n. 款待、令人愉快的东西。过去式 treated；常用 treat sb kindly / treat sb for an illness。
collocations: treat people kindly; treat a patient; a special treat
commonMistake: treat 作“对待某人”时直接接宾语；作“治疗”也可接病人或疾病，如 treat a patient for a cold。

example.english: We should treat every new student kindly.
example.chinese: 我们应该友善地对待每一位新同学。

application.prompt: The school nurse will ___ the cut on Ben’s hand. (treat / follow)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. & v. 尊敬。作动词直接接人或规则；作名词常用 show respect for sb/sth。
collocations: respect the rules; respect other people; show respect for teachers
commonMistake: 作动词时说 respect someone，不在宾语前加 for；作名词时可说 respect for someone。

example.english: Students should respect one another and the school rules.
example.chinese: 学生应该互相尊重并尊重校规。

application.prompt: We must ___ the classroom rules. (respect / respectful)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: conj. 如果。引导条件从句；谈将来的真实条件时，if 从句通常用一般现在时，主句可用 will + 动词原形。
collocations: if it rains; if you need help; if possible
commonMistake: 表示将来的条件时，通常说 If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside；不在 if 从句中用 will 表将来。

example.english: If you do not understand a rule, ask your teacher.
example.chinese: 如果你不理解某条规定，就问老师。

application.prompt: The plan is for tomorrow: If it rains, we ___ inside. (will stay / stayed)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 夹克衫；短上衣。可数名词，复数 jackets；常与 wear、put on 搭配。
collocations: wear a jacket; put on your jacket; a warm jacket
commonMistake: put on 强调穿上的动作，wear 表示穿着的状态；jacket 是可数名词。

example.english: Hang your jacket by the classroom door.
example.chinese: 把你的夹克挂在教室门边。

application.prompt: It is cold outside, so take a warm ___. (jacket / uniform)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，表示因规则或情况“不得不、必须”。have to 随主语变化为 has to；过去式 had to；否定 don’t have to 表示“不必”，mustn’t 才表示“禁止”。
collocations: have to follow the rules; have to wear a uniform; don’t have to come
commonMistake: don’t have to 是“没有必要”，不等于 mustn’t“禁止”；第三人称单数用 has to。

example.english: We have to arrive at school before the first lesson.
example.chinese: 我们必须在第一节课前到校。

application.prompt: Our class rules say we ___ keep the hallway clean. (have to / don’t have to)

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: must and have to

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: pron. 每件事；一切。作单数看待，后接单数谓语；形容词通常放在它后面。
collocations: everything is ready; everything in the bag; do everything
commonMistake: everything 虽表示多件事，语法上仍作单数：Everything is ready，不说 Everything are ready。

example.english: Everything is ready for the class meeting.
example.chinese: 班会要用的东西都准备好了。

application.prompt: The books, maps, and pens are ready. ___ is ready for class. (Everything / Everyone)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 借给；借出。lend—lent—lent；结构为 lend sb sth 或 lend sth to sb。
collocations: lend me a pencil; lend a book to a friend; lend a hand
commonMistake: lend 是把东西借给别人；borrow 是向别人借。过去式和过去分词都是 lent。

example.english: Could you lend me your ruler for a minute?
example.chinese: 你能把尺子借给我用一会儿吗？

application.prompt: I need a pencil. Can you ___ me one? (lend / borrow)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 糖果；adj. 甜的。作名词时英式英语常指一颗糖果，复数 sweets；作形容词可描述食物味道。
collocations: a sweet; a bag of sweets; sweet tea
commonMistake: sweet 作形容词时说 The tea is sweet；表示一颗糖果时可说 a sweet，复数 sweets。

example.english: The shop sells sweets and sweet fruit juice.
example.chinese: 这家店卖糖果和甜果汁。

application.prompt: Lemonade with sugar tastes ___. (sweet / sweets)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 点心；小吃。可数名词，复数 snacks；常指两餐之间少量吃的食物。
collocations: have a snack; a healthy snack; a snack after school
commonMistake: snack 是可数名词，表示一份小吃时要说 a snack；泛指多份时用 snacks。

example.english: I have a small snack after school.
example.chinese: 我放学后吃一点小吃。

application.prompt: At four o’clock, I eat a small ___ before dinner. (snack / uniform)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，表示“当然”；常用于肯定回答或补充说明。语气取决于上下文和语调。
collocations: Of course.; of course not; of course you can
commonMistake: of course 是固定短语，通常不要拆开；友好回答请求时可说 Of course.。

example.english: “May I borrow your pen?” “Of course.”
example.chinese: “我可以借你的笔吗？”“当然可以。”

application.prompt: “Can I sit here?” “___.” (Of course / Of course not) Use a friendly yes.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. 可移动的；能移动的。常作定语修饰名词；mobile phone 中 mobile 表示便携、可移动的。
collocations: mobile chair; mobile phone; mobile equipment
commonMistake: mobile 作形容词表示可移动的；mobile phone 才是“手机”，不要把 mobile 单独当作 phone 的完整表达。

example.english: The table has wheels, so it is easy to move and very mobile.
example.chinese: 这张桌子有轮子，所以很容易移动。

application.prompt: This chair has wheels and can be moved easily. It is ___. (mobile / unhappy)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 手机。可数名词，复数 mobile phones；英式英语常用 mobile phone，美式英语常说 cell phone。
collocations: use a mobile phone; mobile phone number; turn off your mobile phone
commonMistake: mobile phone 是完整名词短语；mobile 单独作形容词时表示“可移动的”。

example.english: Please turn off your mobile phone during the exam.
example.chinese: 考试期间请关掉手机。

application.prompt: Complete the textbook term for a handheld telephone: mobile ___. (phone / hallway)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语动词，关掉（水、电或煤气等）。可分开使用；宾语是代词时放在 turn 和 off 之间，如 turn it off。
collocations: turn off the lights; turn off the tap; turn it off
commonMistake: 代词宾语放在中间：turn it off；不说 turn off it。

example.english: Turn off the lights before you leave the classroom.
example.chinese: 离开教室前关灯。

application.prompt: The computer is still on. Please ___ it ___.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 队；队列。可数名词，常指等候服务的人或车辆；英式英语常用 queue，美式英语常说 line。
collocations: wait in a queue; join the queue; a queue of people
commonMistake: 常说 wait in a queue 或 queue for a bus；不要与 cue（提示、暗示）混淆。

example.english: We waited in a queue to buy lunch.
example.chinese: 我们排队买午餐。

application.prompt: People are waiting one behind another to buy tickets. They are in a ___. (queue / hallway)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，插队；指越过正在等候的人，抢到队伍前面。常用于英式英语；美式英语常说 jump the line。
collocations: don’t jump the queue; try to jump the queue; jump the queue at the shop
commonMistake: queue 是英式英语中“队伍”；jump the queue 表示插到队伍前面，不是正常排队。

example.english: Please don’t jump the queue; everyone has been waiting.
example.chinese: 请不要插队，大家都等了一会儿了。

application.prompt: A student moves in front of everyone already waiting. The student tries to ___. (jump the queue / wait in the queue)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 喂养；饲养。feed—fed—fed；可用 feed sb/sth 或 feed sth to sb/sth。
collocations: feed the class pet; feed a baby; feed the birds
commonMistake: feed 的过去式和过去分词是 fed，不是 feeded；注意 feed the cat 与 feed food to the cat 两种结构。

example.english: I feed our class rabbit before the first lesson.
example.chinese: 第一节课前我会喂班里的兔子。

application.prompt: Give food to the rabbit every morning: ___ the rabbit. (feed / follow)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 离开；留下。leave—left—left；leave a place 表示离开某地，leave sth somewhere 表示把某物留在某处。
collocations: leave school; leave a message; leave a bag at home
commonMistake: leave school 可表示离开学校；leave a book at home 表示把书落在家里。过去式是 left。

example.english: We leave school at four thirty on Fridays.
example.chinese: 我们星期五四点半离校。

application.prompt: The last lesson ends at 4:30, and we ___ school then. (leave / leaves)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. 缺席的；不在的。常作表语，常见结构 be absent from + 活动或地点。
collocations: be absent today; be absent from school; absent from class
commonMistake: absent 是形容词，通常与 be 连用；说“缺席某活动”用 absent from。

example.english: Mia was absent yesterday because she was ill.
example.chinese: 米娅昨天因病缺席。

application.prompt: Kai is at home sick and is not at school today. He is ___. (absent / present)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，表示“缺席；不在”；结构为 be absent from + 学校、课程、会议等。
collocations: absent from school; absent from class; absent from a meeting
commonMistake: absent from 中 from 后接缺席的场合；absent 是形容词，不要漏掉 be 动词。

example.english: Ben is absent from school today.
example.chinese: 本今天没有到校。

application.prompt: Rita missed the whole lesson because she was ill. She was ___ class. (absent from / late for)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: interj. 嘘；用来提醒别人安静。常用于句首，可单独作感叹语。
collocations: Shh!; say “shh”; shh, be quiet
commonMistake: shh 是表示安静的感叹语，不是动词；句首通常大写为 Shh!。

example.english: Shh! The class is taking a test.
example.chinese: 嘘！班里正在考试。

application.prompt: A baby is asleep. Ask people to be quiet: “___!” (Shh / Hello)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adv. 轻声地；安静地。修饰动词；形容词形式是 quiet。
collocations: speak quietly; walk quietly; sit quietly
commonMistake: quiet 是形容词，quietly 是副词；修饰 speak 或 walk 时用 quietly。

example.english: Please speak quietly in the hallway.
example.chinese: 请在走廊里轻声说话。

application.prompt: The baby is sleeping, so please walk ___. (quiet / quietly)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 安全带；腰带；皮带。可数名词，复数 belts；seat belt 指汽车安全带。
collocations: fasten a seat belt; wear a belt; a leather belt
commonMistake: seat belt 是安全带；腰间束衣服的 belt 是腰带。单数可数名词前要有 a/the 等限定词。

example.english: Please fasten your seat belt before the car moves.
example.chinese: 汽车开动前请系好安全带。

application.prompt: Before the car starts, fasten your seat ___.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 声音；噪声。泛指噪声时通常不可数；指某一个具体声响时可数，如 a strange noise。
collocations: make a noise; loud noise; noise in the hallway
commonMistake: noise 是名词，noisy 是形容词；说“很吵的教室”用 a noisy classroom。

example.english: The noise in the hallway was too loud for a quiet study room.
example.chinese: 走廊里的声音太大，不适合在安静的自习室里学习。

application.prompt: A loud ___ from the machine kept us awake. (noise / noisy)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. 不快乐的。由否定前缀 un- + happy 构成；可作定语或表语。
collocations: feel unhappy; look unhappy; an unhappy student
commonMistake: unhappy 是形容词；作系动词 feel/look 后的表语，不要加副词形式。happy 的反义词可用 unhappy。

example.english: Leo felt unhappy when he lost his notebook.

application.prompt: The opposite of happy, using the prefix un-, is ___. (unhappy / untidy)

collocations: Mary is; Mary’s book; talk to Mary

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配

grammar: 专有名词，人名“托尼”。专有名词首字母大写，通常不加冠词。
collocations: Tony is; Tony’s bag; ask Tony
commonMistake: 人名 Tony 首字母大写；所有格写 Tony’s，不写 tonys。

example.english: Tony waits in the queue for lunch.
example.chinese: 托尼排队买午餐。

application.prompt: Correct the capitalization of this first name: tony.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 专有名词，人名“安妮”。专有名词首字母大写，通常不加冠词。
collocations: Anne is; Anne’s class; write to Anne

example.english: Anne lends her ruler to a classmate.
example.chinese: 安妮把尺子借给一位同学。

application.prompt: Correct the capitalization and spelling of this first name: anne.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 专有名词，人名“埃里克”。专有名词首字母大写，通常不加冠词。
collocations: Eric is; Eric’s uniform; help Eric
commonMistake: Eric 是人名，首字母大写；所有格写 Eric’s。

example.english: Eric is on time for the first lesson.
example.chinese: 埃里克准时上了第一节课。

application.prompt: Correct the capitalization of this first name: eric.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. doctor 的缩写，表示“博士；医生”，通常放在人名或姓氏前作称呼，如 Dr Lee。英式写法常不加句点，美式也常写 Dr.。
collocations: Dr Lee; Dr Brown; ask Dr Green
commonMistake: Dr 放在人名或姓氏前并首字母大写；本词表写作 Dr，美式英语中也可写 Dr.。

example.english: Dr Lee visited our school to talk about health.
example.chinese: 李医生来我们学校讲解健康知识。

application.prompt: Use the title before the surname: ___ Brown. (Dr / dr)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，整理床铺；铺床。make—made—made；sb’s 可换成 my、your、his、her、our、their 等所有格。
collocations: make my bed; make the bed; make your bed every morning
commonMistake: 表示整理床铺说 make the bed，不说 do the bed；使用具体人物时用所有格，如 make her bed。

example.english: I make my bed before breakfast.
example.chinese: 我在早餐前整理床铺。

application.prompt: Before breakfast, I ___ to keep my room tidy. (Use the phrase with “my”.)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adv. 也（用于否定词组后）。常放在否定句末；与 too 通常用于肯定句不同。
collocations: not ... either; I don’t either; neither ... nor
commonMistake: either 表示“也”用于否定句末，如 I don’t know either；肯定句通常用 too 或 also。

example.english: I don’t use my phone in class either.
example.chinese: 我上课时也不用手机。

application.prompt: My brother isn’t late, and I am not late ___.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 训练；练习。英式英语中 practise 是动词，practise—practised—practised；后接名词或动词-ing。
collocations: practise English; practise speaking; practise for a test
commonMistake: 按本词表的英式拼写，动词写 practise，名词写 practice；美式英语中 practice 可作动词和名词。

example.english: We practise speaking English after class.
example.chinese: 我们课后练习说英语。

application.prompt: Use the British spelling shown in this book: We ___ the dialogue every day. (practise / practice)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 悬挂。表示把物品挂起时，过去式和过去分词通常为 hung；现在分词 hanging。
collocations: hang a jacket on a hook; hang a picture; hang up your coat
commonMistake: hang 表示悬挂时用 hung 作过去式和过去分词；hanged 主要用于“绞死”，初中常用义记 hung。

example.english: Hang your jacket on the hook, please.
example.chinese: 请把夹克挂在挂钩上。

application.prompt: Please ___ your coat on the hook. (hang / hangs)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语动词，闲逛；常去某处。常用 hang out with sb 或 hang out at/in a place；过去式 hung out。
collocations: hang out with friends; hang out at the park; hang out after school
commonMistake: hang out 表示和朋友一起消磨时间；作过去式时说 hung out，不说 hanged out。

example.english: My friends and I hang out in the yard after school.
example.chinese: 放学后我和朋友们在院子里闲逛。

application.prompt: After homework, we spend time together at the park. We ___ there. (hang out / hang up)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 工作日，星期一至星期五中的任何一天。可数名词，复数 weekdays；与 weekend 相对。
collocations: on weekdays; a weekday morning; weekday routine
commonMistake: weekday 指周一至周五的某一天，不包括 Saturday 和 Sunday；weekend 指周末。

example.english: I get up early on weekdays.
example.chinese: 我工作日早起。

application.prompt: Monday is a ___, but Saturday is part of the weekend.

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. 糟糕的；讨厌的。可作定语或表语；非正式语境中表示非常差。
collocations: awful weather; feel awful; an awful noise
commonMistake: awful 是形容词；修饰名词或放在 be/feel 等系动词后，不要误写为副词。

example.english: The weather was awful, so we stayed inside.
example.chinese: 天气很糟糕，所以我们待在室内。

application.prompt: The trip was not enjoyable at all; the weather was ___. (awful / polite)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 变成；成为。become—became—become；后接名词或形容词作表语。
collocations: become a teacher; become quiet; become better
commonMistake: become 的过去式是 became，过去分词是 become；become 后可直接接形容词，如 become quiet。

example.english: The hallway became quiet after the bell rang.
example.chinese: 铃响后走廊安静了下来。

application.prompt: Yesterday, the hallway ___ quiet after the bell. (became / become)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. & adv. 较好的；较好地。是 good 和 well 的比较级；常用于 than 结构。
collocations: a better idea; feel better; do better than before
commonMistake: better 是 good/well 的不规则比较级，不说 gooder；作形容词修饰名词，作副词修饰动作。

example.english: This rule helps us work better together.
example.chinese: 这条规则有助于我们更好地合作。

application.prompt: This plan is good, but the second plan is ___. (better / gooder)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 人。可数名词，复数通常为 people；persons 也可用于正式或法律语境。
collocations: one person; two people; a person in the hallway
commonMistake: person 的常见复数是 people，不是 persons；one person 表示一个人。

example.english: Every person in our class follows the rules.
example.chinese: 我们班的每个人都遵守规则。

application.prompt: One human being is one ___. (person / people)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 集中（注意力、精力等）；聚焦。常用 focus on + 名词或动词-ing；第三人称单数 focuses。
collocations: focus on the task; focus your attention; focus carefully
commonMistake: 表示“集中注意力于……”要用 focus on；主语是 he/she/it 时动词写 focuses。

example.english: Please focus on the teacher’s instructions.
example.chinese: 请把注意力集中在老师的指示上。

application.prompt: During the test, we must ___ on our work. (focus / focuses)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，集中（注意力、精力等）于。on 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。
collocations: focus on a task; focus on studying; focus on the main idea
commonMistake: focus on 后接名词或动词-ing；不能说 focus on to do sth。

example.english: I focus on one task at a time.
example.chinese: 我一次专注于一项任务。

application.prompt: Listen carefully and pay attention to the instructions: ___ the instructions. (focus on / turn off)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 创建；建造。build—built—built；既可指建造建筑，也可指逐步形成习惯或关系。
collocations: build a house; build good habits; build a team
commonMistake: build 的过去式和过去分词都是 built，不是 builded。

example.english: Following a routine can help us build good habits.
example.chinese: 遵循日常安排能帮助我们养成好习惯。

application.prompt: The workers will ___ a new classroom next year. (build / built)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 精神；情绪。可数或不可数，具体含义看搭配；team spirit 指团队精神，in high spirits 指情绪高涨。
collocations: team spirit; school spirit; in high spirits
commonMistake: team spirit 通常不加冠词表示团队精神；表示某种情绪或精神时依搭配判断可数性。

example.english: Team spirit helps our class work together.
example.chinese: 团队精神帮助我们班团结合作。

application.prompt: The team supports one another and works together. It has strong team ___. (spirit / advice)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: 短语，思考；考虑。think—thought—thought；about 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。
collocations: think about a question; think about the result; think about doing sth
commonMistake: think about 后接名词或动词-ing；think about doing sth 表示考虑做某事。

example.english: Think about the rule before you act.
example.chinese: 行动前先想一想这条规则。

application.prompt: Before making a choice, you should ___ the results. (think about / turn off)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 放松；休息。规则变化 relax—relaxed—relaxed；可用 relax after sth 或 relax by doing sth。
collocations: relax after school; relax at home; relax by listening to music
commonMistake: relax 是动词，描述“放松的”可用 relaxed；描述令人放松的事物可用 relaxing。

example.english: I listen to music to relax after school.
example.chinese: 我放学后听音乐放松。

application.prompt: Take a deep breath and ___ before the test. (relax / relaxed)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: n. 建议；意见。不可数名词；可说 some advice 或 a piece of advice。
collocations: ask for advice; give advice; a piece of advice
commonMistake: advice 不可数，不说 an advice 或 advices；表示一条建议用 a piece of advice。

example.english: My teacher gave me useful advice about studying.
example.chinese: 老师给了我一些关于学习的有用建议。

application.prompt: Can I ask you for some ___ about my project? (advice / advices)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: v. 理解；领会。understand—understood—understood；可直接接名词或从句。
collocations: understand a rule; understand the question; understand what to do
commonMistake: understand 的过去式和过去分词都是 understood；不说 understanded。

example.english: I understand the rule now.
example.chinese: 我现在理解这条规定了。

application.prompt: The directions are clear, so I can ___ them. (understand / understood)

examTags: 词汇·词义与搭配
语法·规则表达与情境运用
grammar: adj. 不整洁的。由 un- + tidy 构成；可作定语或表语。
collocations: an untidy desk; an untidy room; look untidy
commonMistake: untidy 是形容词，表示“不整洁的”；反义词是 tidy。

example.english: His desk is untidy, with books on the floor.
example.chinese: 他的书桌不整洁，书都放在地板上。

application.prompt: Choose the adjective meaning “not tidy”: ___. (untidy / polite)
